meaning: 游戏主机（专用游戏设备）
usageNote: 名词！英式说法，就是PS5、Switch那种东西。美国人更爱说game console，去掉s！

examples.en: He got a new games console for his birthday and played all night.
examples.zh: 他生日收到了一台新游戏主机，玩了一整夜。

examples.en: The games console was so popular that it sold out within minutes.
examples.zh: 这款游戏主机太火了，几分钟内就卖光了。
